'''Snipp Nkik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was a member of the [[Nkik clan]] of Jawas, which also included [[Het Nkik/Legends|Het Nkik]] and [[Jek Nkik]]. In addition to being a member of this clan, he was associated with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and was an active member of his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|his criminal empire]]. He often was seen with [[Herat]], another Jawa member of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] court. Snipp was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] infiltrated the palace along with other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] including [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

==Behind the scenes==
Snipp is identifiable in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] as the Jawa wearing a bandolier over the right shoulder. He was played by [[Brian Wheeler]].<ref>{{YouTube|video=vxtwjecBxn0|text=The deleted Jawa scene by actor BRIAN WHEELER - Star Wars 100 Interviews|channel=@StarWars100Interviews|name=Star Wars 100 Interviews|date=2016-11-30}}</ref> Snipp also is the Jawa holding [[Buboicullaar/Legends|Buboicullaar's]] leash in both the film and numerous on-set production photos.

The name of Snipp Nkik was first revealed in [[Star Wars Insider 134|''Star Wars Insider'' 134]], in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] department. In said issue it was titled ''An audience with Jabba the Hutt'' and included the names of 29 members of the Hutt's court. Snipp was the only newly identified character in the issue, however the [[Rock wart/Legends|rock wart]] in Jabba's Palace was identified on-screen.
